# Mia Tran – Land your first freelance client in 30 days

> Demo landing page for a fictional coach who helps designers go freelance. Built by Duong Thanh Nam (https://duongthanhnam.vercel.app) as a portfolio example. Mia Tran, her guide, course and reviews are not real.

## What the page offers

- A free 24-page guide, "Land your first freelance client in 30 days", sent by email after sign-up
- The guide's 7 steps: pick a niche, build a 3-project portfolio, set first prices, find 20 leads in a week, write messages that get replies, run a first client call, deliver and get a testimonial
- A paid course: 6 weekly video lessons, portfolio and pricing templates, a live group call every Friday, a private community and lifetime access, with a 14-day refund

## Pages

- [Home](https://mia-tran-coach.vercel.app): guide sign-up, guide outline, about, reviews, course offer and FAQ
